symptom: my IMU stops answering after I soldered the AD0 jumper. The old address in the driver times out now.

files.imu.py:
from mpu6050 import MPU6050
sensor = MPU6050(0x68)
print(sensor.get_accel_data())

gold.diagnosis: AD0 high moves the device to 0x69. WHO_AM_I (0x75) confirms 0x68 silicon at the new address. Use address=0x69.
